listing.name: The King of Fighters '98 (KOF'98 Recomp)
listing.summary: Attach the prepared KOF ’98 AES Windows player using your own kof98h cartridge and AES BIOS files. Select the native game with its ROM directory, retaining settings and all actual state; the Windows preparation path remains upstream-untried.

steps.title: Prepare the exact AES original and BIOS
steps.instruction: Use your own KOF ’98 home/AES kof98h (NGH-2420), not the MVS kof98 set. The selected mapping uses 242-pn1.bin and 242-p2.bin, 242-s1.bin, 242-mg1.bin, 242-c1.bin through 242-c8.bin and 242-v1.bin through 242-v4.bin. It requires the AES neo-po.bin BIOS plus sfix.sfix, sm1.sm1 and 000-lo.lo from your own compatible BIOS set; the toolkit’s generic MVS example is not this game’s BIOS selection. Upstream docs/game-notes.md owns the per-file CRCs. No cartridge, BIOS, setup helper, compiler or game is accessed or executed here.

steps.title: Complete the supported upstream build
steps.instruction: Follow the selected project’s Windows setup or documented step-by-step source preparation with SDL2 and ROM-derived recompilation enabled. The offered installer is a preparation tool, not the game. Upstream explicitly says its Windows quick setup has not yet been tried with this title; that is an unobserved route, not a demonstrated pass or known failure. A development interpreter-only or headless build is not the prepared windowed player described here. Keep the full project, generated output, runtime libraries, notices and owned inputs.

steps.title: Attach the native player directly
steps.instruction: After successful upstream preparation, select build/Release/kof98.exe, use the prepared project root as working directory and set --rom-path "the actual existing project roms directory". Review the exact paths and intent and request Play separately. This follows the generated shortcut’s target, CWD and ROM argument; the generated KOF98.cmd uses start and detaches, so do not register it. Leave --headless, --verify and profiling/test options out of ordinary Play. Close the game normally before ending the session.

steps.title: Preserve settings and actual state
steps.instruction: The selected SDL consumer stores settings.ini in SDL_GetPrefPath("neogeorecomp", "kof98"), normally %APPDATA%/neogeorecomp/kof98 on Windows. Keep that actual resolved root, project ROMs, generated caches, logs, any existing game state and historical copies. Menu/settings persistence is established in source; durable score, SRAM, memory-card or save-state compatibility has not been established by this guide. Do not invent a save conversion, replace populated data with a new folder, or delete originals. No migration or real-save restore is performed.

steps.title: Retain the title-specific limits
steps.instruction: Keep project/toolkit MIT and all SDL2, Musashi, Z80 and audio-library notices; these do not license original cartridge/BIOS assets. The title compiles its mapped 68000 code while retaining a runtime-copied boot routine and separate sound/hardware implementation; it is not proof that every CPU path is static. Upstream scripted block comparisons and gameplay reports are not observations on this host. Quit before upstream replacement, keep recovery and review/relink changed bytes. No native/installed, physical multiplayer/controller, Supported or managed lifecycle acceptance is asserted.

warnings: Use AES kof98h with the AES BIOS, not an MVS set. Windows preparation is explicitly untried upstream; only attach an actually completed windowed native build, preserving its existing data.
